name: freqtrade-strategies Bandtastic
translation_notes: Uses the strategy's default hyperopt parameters. Entry (default trigger bb_lower1; the optional RSI/MFI/EMA buy guards are disabled by default): close below the lower Bollinger(20, 1) band. Exit (default trigger sell-bb_upper2): close above the upper Bollinger(20, 2) band; the default-enabled MFI > 46 exit guard is dropped (no MFI in the registry). The band multiplier differs between entry and exit, so the plan uses two Bollinger aliases (bb1, bb2). Bands use close; the original uses typical price. The ROI table (0 min: 16.2%, 69: 9.7%, 229: 6.1%, 566: 0%) becomes a single 16.2% take-profit. Stop-loss 34.5% kept: it is inside the lab's (0, 50] stop-loss bound, so no clamping was needed. The trailing stop (+1% once +5.8% is reached) is dropped: the lab engine has no trailing stop. Timeframe changed 15m -> 1h to match the other seeds.
